data.exact_reserve_text: IQUW Holdings, through a subsidiary, participated on the 2022 and 2021 years of account. The result for the 2022 and 2021 years of account is a loss of GBP 12.2 million. Capacity for the 2020 & prior years of account is backed by Credit Suisse and Humboldt Re Limited. The result for the 2020 and prior underwriting years in calendar year 2022 was a loss of GBP 1.5 million. The 2020 and prior result included an additional GBP 5.6 million risk premium above the core best estimate reserve in order to close the year into the 2021 year of account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate has exposure on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years to losses arising out of COVID and currently has reserved GBP 21.6 million gross of reinsurance and GBP 21.6 million net of reinsurance. These losses primarily arose in property reinsurance.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2020 and prior years have been closed into the 2021 year of the Syndicate with the support of an adverse development cover placed with Artex SAC Limited acting on behalf of two of its segregated accounts. An ADC cover of $20 million was put in place to close the 2020 YOA.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1856 reported opening gross claims reserves of GBP 166.393m at 1 Jan 2022. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 1.525m (about 0.92% of opening gross reserves), driven by mixed development across older years with offsetting releases and deterioration. The 2022 calendar year was materially impacted by catastrophe events (notably Hurricane Ian) and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, and the Syndicate continues to hold targeted risk margins and specific reserves (including COVID-related reserves of GBP 21.6m gross). The net prior-year movement calculated from the gross triangle is a modest strengthening overall.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2022 result was materially impacted by the Russia-Ukraine Conflict (GBP 19.7million) and catastrophe events in the year, including claims arising from Hurricane Ian (GBP 56.9 million).
Total catastrophe claims incurred by the Syndicate in 2022 amounted to GBP 93.7 million, GBP 44.8 million above expectations.
The booked reserves for these losses as at 31 December 2022 are GBP 43.5 million gross of reinsurance and GBP 19.7 million net of reinsurance.

The Syndicate has exposure on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years to losses arising out of COVID and currently has reserved GBP 21.6 million gross of reinsurance and GBP 21.6 million net of reinsurance (2021: GBP 19.1million gross and GBP 19.1 million net).
booked reserves include a net margin of GBP 9.8 million above the best estimate
The 2020 and prior result included an additional GBP 5.6 million risk premium above the core best estimate reserve in order to close the year into the 2021 year of account.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (diagonal comparison) because there is no explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure in the notes. The triangle is not distorted by an explicit 'X and prior' aggregate column for the individual years used, but RITC and ADC activity is present (2020->2021), which may affect comparability. Premium divisional totals were summed from divisional breakdowns and a small residual 'Other' added to reconcile to total gross premium.
